confidence.description: How much the report engine should trust this entry. 'official' means taken from a published standard; 'verified' means confirmed against a real vehicle whose behaviour was known; 'community' means contributed but unconfirmed.

name.description: Stable machine key. Rules reference PIDs by this name, so renaming one is a breaking change.

bytes.description: Expected payload length. A response shorter than this is treated as a malformed answer rather than silently zero-padded.

formula.description: Arithmetic over A,B,C,D... (individual bytes), U (whole window as unsigned big-endian) and S (whole window as signed two's-complement).

decoder.description: Name of a builtin decoder in carpi.core.protocol.decoders, for bitfields and enums that arithmetic cannot express.

range.description: Physically plausible [min, max] after decoding. Values outside it are reported as suspect rather than as fact.
